# Life OS

Life OS is an open-source, self-hostable personal operating system and digital brain.

Repository: https://github.com/karim-coder/life-os
License: MIT
Primary language: TypeScript
Framework: Next.js
Database: Prisma with SQLite by default

## Summary

Life OS helps people manage tasks, notes, journals, habits, finances, calendar events, projects, contacts, goals, reflections, and life domains in one connected system. It can be described as a habit tracker, journal app, task manager, goal tracker, focus timer, calendar planner, finance tracker, second brain, personal knowledge management system, and digital brain.

## Main features

- Digital Brain graph with linked tasks, notes, journals, projects, goals, and habits.
- Master calendar for tasks, bills, appointments, and scheduled items.
- Quick capture inbox for ideas and tasks.
- Habit tracking with streaks and heatmaps, focus timer, journal editor, daily reviews, weekly reviews, and insights.
- Self-hostable authentication with optional two-factor authentication.
- Optional AI smart inbox processing.
- PWA support and Docker support.
